entries.description: Compared template-seed workflow assets with the accepted app baseline, compatibility notes, and template guardrails using routed analysis to confirm the current seed stays workflow-focused and aligned by omission.

Ran a constrained routed defaults review to identify the workflow-doc, instruction-template, and starter-session guidance changes Session 2 should make without turning template-seed into an application scaffold.

Created docs/planning/notes-driven-template-contract-audit.md to record the template contract verdict, Session 2 update list, explicit limitations, and risks to avoid while keeping template-seed workflow-focused.

Ran dotnet build and dotnet test for Dabbler.Platform.sln. The initial parallel attempt hit MSBuild file-lock contention, then the required sequential rerun succeeded with build passing and all 366 tests passing.
Sent the Session 1 planning artifact, activity log, spec excerpt, and sequential build/test results to external session verification and saved the raw review output.

Updated template-seed/README.md and the starter session-set spec to make the workflow-only bootstrap contract explicit and to define starter standards around retained notes-driven surfaces and deliberate opt-ins.

Updated template-seed/AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and docs/ai-led-session-workflow.md so new repos inherit the narrowed notes-driven guidance without implying older broad shell, dashboard, query/report, or security defaults.

Confirmed the template seed now treats obsolete or compatibility-only catalog/query-report surfaces, catalog and usage-tracking wiring, favorites/recent-items widgets, query CSV export, report print/zoom controls, and multiselect lookups as explicit choices instead of starter defaults.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully, then reran dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln sequentially after a parallel attempt reproduced the known MSBuild file-lock race. The required sequential validation passed with all 366 tests passing.

Sent the Session 2 spec context, Session 1 audit handoff, activity log entries, changed template-file contents, and sequential build/test results to external session verification and saved the raw review output.
